import re, datetime
# Gather all inbox threads related to Spotify verification code
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
thread_candidates = []
while True:
    page = apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(access_token=gmail_token, query='Spotify Account Verficiation Code', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
    print('page_index', page_index, 'num_threads', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    thread_candidates.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_candidates', len(thread_candidates))
# sort by created_at desc
thread_candidates_sorted = sorted(thread_candidates, key=lambda t: t.get('created_at',''), reverse=True)
print('top3_thread_ids_created_at', [(t['email_thread_id'], t.get('created_at')) for t in thread_candidates_sorted[:3]])

# Inspect most recent thread(s) for verification code in body
latest_threads = thread_candidates_sorted[:3]
codes = []
for t in latest_threads:
    tid = t['email_thread_id']
    full = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_token)
    # concatenate all email bodies
    bodies = [email.get('body','') for email in full.get('emails',[])]
    combined = '\n'.join(bodies)
    # look for 4-8 digit codes
    found = re.findall(r'\b\d{4,8}\b', combined)
    print('thread', tid, 'found_numbers_sample', found[:10], 'count', len(found))
    # often verification code is a single number; pick the first with reasonable length
    if found:
        # choose the longest string in case multiple
        code = sorted(found, key=len, reverse=True)[0]
        codes.append((tid, code))

print('extracted_codes', codes)

lines = [ln.rstrip() for ln in content.splitlines()]

def parse_items_from_bullets(start_idx):
    items=[]
    i=start_idx
    while i < len(lines):
        ln = lines[i].strip()
        if ln.startswith('#'):
            break
        if ln.startswith('## '):
            break
        if ln.startswith('- '):
            items.append(lines[i][2:])
            i+=1
            continue
        if ln=='' or ln.startswith('##') or ln.startswith('#'):
            i+=1
            continue
        # unknown line; skip
        i+=1
    return items

# We'll do manual state machine

    ln = lines[i]
    if ln.startswith('# Song Library'):
        section='songs'
        i+=1
        continue
    if ln.startswith('# Album Library'):
        section='albums'
        i+=1
        continue
    if ln.startswith('# Playlists'):
        section='playlists'
        i+=1
        continue
    if ln.startswith('## '):
        current_playlist = ln[3:].strip()
        playlists[current_playlist]=[]
        i+=1
        continue
    if ln.startswith('- ') and section=='songs':
        songs.append(ln[2:])
    elif ln.startswith('- ') and section=='albums':
        albums.append(ln[2:])
    elif ln.startswith('- ') and section=='playlists':
        if current_playlist is None:
            print('warning: song under playlists without playlist header at line', i, ln)
        else:
            playlists[current_playlist].append(ln[2:])
    i+=1

import re

def split_title_artists(item):
    # Expect 'Title by Artist1, Artist2'
    m = re.match(r'^(.*) by (.*)$', item)
    if not m:
        return item.strip(), []
    title = m.group(1).strip()
    artist_str = m.group(2).strip()
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_str.split(',') if a.strip()]
    return title, artists

    best_score=None

    title = m.group(1).strip()
    artist_str = m.group(2).strip()
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_str.split(',') if a.strip()]
    return title, artists

def parse_music_txt():
    music = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path='~/backups/music.txt', access_token=fs_token)
    content = music['content']
    lines = [ln.rstrip() for ln in content.splitlines()]

    albums_section=[]

    current_playlist=None
    for ln in lines:
        if ln.startswith('# Song Library'):
            section='songs'; current_playlist=None; continue
        if ln.startswith('# Album Library'):
            section='albums'; current_playlist=None; continue
        if ln.startswith('# Playlists'):
            section='playlists'; current_playlist=None; continue
        if ln.startswith('## '):
            current_playlist=ln[3:].strip()
            playlists_section[current_playlist]=[]
            continue

            item=ln[2:].strip()
            if section=='songs':
                songs_section.append(item)
            elif section=='albums':

def best_song_from_catalog(exp_title, exp_artists):
    exp_title_n = normalize(exp_title)
    exp_artist_norms = set(normalize(a) for a in exp_artists if normalize(a))

    # Prefer exact title candidates
    candidates = cands_by_title.get(exp_title_n, [])

    def score_candidate(c):
        cand_title_n = normalize(c.get('title'))
        cand_artist_norms = set(normalize(a.get('name')) for a in c.get('artists',[]) if normalize(a.get('name')))
        title_exact = 1 if cand_title_n == exp_title_n and exp_title_n else 0
        overlap = len(exp_artist_norms & cand_artist_norms)
        # partial title bonus
        partial = 0
        if exp_title_n and cand_title_n:
            if exp_title_n in cand_title_n or cand_title_n in exp_title_n:
                partial = 1
        # Score: exact title dominates
        return (title_exact*1000) + overlap*10 + partial

    best=None
    best_score=None

    if candidates:
        for c in candidates:
            sc = score_candidate(c)
            if best is None or sc>best_score:
                best=c
                best_score=sc
        return best

    # Fallback: scan all songs
    for c in catalog_songs:
        sc = score_candidate(c)
        if best is None or sc>best_score:
            best=c
            best_score=sc
    return best
